nodes.description: Owner address of the Owned contract; set to msg.sender at deployment and checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending new owner address used by the two-step ownership transfer (transferOwnership/acceptOwnership).
Token symbol 'EMC' set in the EduMetrix constructor.
Token name 'EduMetrix' set in the EduMetrix constructor.
Token decimals, set to 18 in the EduMetrix constructor.
Total token supply state variable, assigned once in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping(address => uint) of token balances; mutated by transfer, transferFrom and the constructor.
Nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) of ERC20 allowances; written by approve/approveAndCall and spent in transferFrom.
Owned() constructor that sets owner = msg.sender at deployment.
transferOwnership(address _newOwner) guarded by onlyOwner; stores the pending new owner.
acceptOwnership() lets the pending newOwner claim ownership after checking msg.sender == newOwner.
EduMetrix() constructor that initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-funds the deployer address.
totalSupply() returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction.
balanceOf(address tokenOwner) constant function returning balances[tokenOwner].
transfer(address to, uint tokens) moves tokens from msg.sender, using safeSub/safeAdd and emitting Transfer.
approve(address spender, uint tokens) sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and emits Approval.
transferFrom(address from, address to, uint tokens) spends allowance and moves balances using safeSub/safeAdd.
allowance(address tokenOwner, address spender) constant function returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall(address spender, uint tokens, bytes data) sets allowance then makes an unguarded external call to spender.receiveApproval.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject plain ETH transfers.
Only-owner rescue function performing an external call to ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens).
safeAdd(uint a, uint b) overflow-checked addition helper returning c.
safeSub(uint a, uint b) underflow-checked subtraction helper returning c.
safeMul(uint a, uint b) overflow-checked multiplication helper returning c.
safeDiv(uint a, uint b) division helper with a zero-divisor require.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for ownership, balances and allowance indexing.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) executed after allowance update, enabling reentrancy.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an arbitrary caller-supplied contract, a reentrancy/external-call risk.
Unchecked arithmetic subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] inside totalSupply().

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transferOwnership writes the _newOwner parameter into the newOwner state variable.
transfer uses msg.sender as the source index of the balances mapping.
transfer credits balances[to] with the tokens amount.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] with the tokens amount.
transfer tokens amount parameter flows into safeSub/safeAdd calls.
approve uses spender as the inner index of the allowed mapping.
approve writes the tokens parameter as the allowance value.
transferFrom debits balances[from].
transferFrom tokens amount flows into balance and allowance updates.
transferFrom credits balances[to].
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] allowance.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender] using the tokenOwner parameter.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender] using the spender parameter.
approveAndCall uses the spender parameter as the target of the receiveApproval external call.
msg.sender is forwarded as the from argument of receiveApproval.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter transferFrom before state settles.
The external receiveApproval call can re-enter transfer and move tokens.
transferAnyERC20Token uses the caller-supplied tokenAddress as an external call target.
tokens parameter is passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner to reach the external call.
_totalSupply is the minuend of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply().
balances[address(0)] is the subtrahend of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply().
The unchecked subtraction is executed inside totalSupply().
safeAdd parameter a participates in the guarded addition c = a + b.
safeAdd parameter b participates in the guarded addition c = a + b.
safeSub parameter a participates in the guarded subtraction c = a - b.
safeSub parameter b participates in the guarded subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul parameter a participates in the guarded multiplication c = a * b.
safeMul parameter b participates in the guarded multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv parameter a is the dividend of the guarded division.
safeDiv parameter b is the divisor checked by require(b > 0).
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf returns the value stored in the balances mapping.
allowance returns the value stored in the allowed mapping.
Named return variable balance of balanceOf is populated from the balances mapping.
Named return variable remaining of allowance is populated from the allowed mapping.
Named return variable c of safeAdd holds the checked addition result.
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for balances and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
The EduMetrix constructor mints _totalSupply into balances of the deployer address.
The EduMetrix constructor assigns the fixed total supply to _totalSupply.
transferAnyERC20Token performs the external ERC20 transfer call under onlyOwner control.
approveAndCall reaches the receiveApproval external call whose callback can re-enter token state.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newOwner only exists to feed transferOwnership; fold it into the owning function node.
Parameter to of transfer is local to the transfer function's balance update.
Parameter tokens of transfer is local to the transfer function's safe arithmetic.
Parameter spender of approve is only used to index the allowance mapping inside approve.
Parameter tokens of approve is only the allowance value written by approve.
Parameter from of transferFrom is only the debited account inside transferFrom.
Parameter to of transferFrom is only the credited account inside transferFrom.
Parameter tokens of transferFrom is only the amount handled inside transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf is only the mapping index read by balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance is only the outer mapping index read by allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance is only the inner mapping index read by allowance.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall is exactly the target of the receiveApproval external call.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall is forwarded into the receiveApproval external call.
Parameter data of approveAndCall is forwarded into the receiveApproval external call.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token is exactly the external call target.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token is passed into the external ERC20 transfer call.
Parameter a is local to the safeAdd arithmetic helper.
Parameter b is local to the safeAdd arithmetic helper.
Parameter a is local to the safeSub arithmetic helper.
Parameter b is local to the safeSub arithmetic helper.
Parameter a is local to the safeMul arithmetic helper.
Parameter b is local to the safeMul arithmetic helper.
Parameter a is local to the safeDiv arithmetic helper.
Parameter b is local to the safeDiv arithmetic helper.
Named return variable balance belongs solely to balanceOf.
Named return variable remaining belongs solely to allowance.
Named return variable c belongs solely to safeAdd.
